title: RoutineUpdatedPayload

routineId.description: A routine's id: a version 4 UUID the creating client mints, so a create can queue offline.

change.description: What changed on a routine: the record appended to its stream, routine.<change>: created, edited, enabled, disabled, deleted, skipped (not no-change), firing-started, firing-continued, firing-ended or delivery-attempted (a final result, not a retry).

description: routine.updated: a routine changed; the client runtime refreshes routines.list, and nobody sees the notice itself.
